subject: prd/tech-design-brainstorm
statement: While orienting, the skill shall read the basis, the live design corpus (the index and matching designs), the architecture principles, the incident registry, the glossary, and prior design-brainstorm records — routing surfaces first — and shall surface every overlap with a live design or prior record before exploration begins.
rationale: direction already decided elsewhere is the cheapest session to end (covered); principles and incidents are the scoring substrate
fit_criterion: on fixtures seeded with a covering live design and a prior record, the overlap is surfaced with its source before any framing/panel
